description: Source code for a Frappe/ERPNext module handling student report generation, including report preview, attendance calculation, and assessment report retrieval.

classes.name: StudentReportGenerationTool
classes.description: A Document subclass representing the student report generation tool.

methods.name: preview_report_card
methods.description: Generates a student report card PDF preview based on provided document data, including assessment results and attendance.

methods.name: get_courses_criteria
methods.description: Retrieves assessment criteria for each course in the provided list.

methods.name: get_attendance_count
methods.description: Calculates attendance counts for a student within a specified academic year or term.
